en.headline: PLA Hong Kong Garrison completes 29th unit rotation
en.dek: The garrison carried out a scheduled rotation of army, navy and air force units between 24 and 25 August under the Garrison Law and a Central Military Commission order.
body: The Chinese People’s Liberation Army Hong Kong Garrison organised its 29th organisational unit rotation of army, navy and air force elements on 24 and 25 August, according to an official statement.

Army units moved in motorised formations from Shenzhen via the Shenzhen Bay Port to camps in Hong Kong and conducted a defence handover ceremony. Navy and air force elements rotated according to plan. The action was completed safely and smoothly with support from Hong Kong and Shenzhen government departments.
Incoming personnel had undergone training before arrival. The garrison said the rotation would further enhance its ability to fulfil defence responsibilities.

zh.headline: 解放軍駐港部隊完成第29次建制單位輪換
zh.dek: 駐港部隊於8月24至25日組織陸軍、海軍、空軍部分兵力進行第29次建制單位輪換，行動全程安全順利。
body: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區駐軍法》及中央軍委命令，中國人民解放軍駐香港部隊於8月24至25日組織陸軍、海軍、空軍部隊部分兵力進行第29次建制單位輪換。
陸軍部隊以梯隊編成、摩托化機動方式由深圳經深圳灣口岸進入港內軍營，並舉行防務交接儀式；海軍及空軍部隊按計劃依次展開輪換。行動得到香港及深圳有關部門支持，全程安全順利。
駐軍表示，輪換進港官兵進駐前已進行訓練，具備履行防務能力，將進一步提升履行防務職責的能力。
